name: ファイルに固有の操作一覧シート
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Redesign ONE actual Lighthouse catalog LH15-0009, file-specific action sheet, eleven existing actions.
Reference1 ORIGINAL primary for every icon glyph, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing and control anatomy. Use only vertical eleven-action list below share toolbar: download; scan four corner brackets framing a rectangle; rename insertion cursor beside small label; four-direction move; overlapping duplicate pages with plus; outline star; access GEAR; lightning activity; cloud with DOWN ARROW; folder with SMALL MAGNIFIER; printer. Preserve OFF switch at far right of offline row. Reference2 OUR MOCK secondary for Japanese labels/order only: correct its generic scan page, text-T rename, people access, arrowless cloud and solid folder substitutes, and restore omitted OFF toggle. Reference3 approved bus white rounded surface/soft depth style only, no borrowed content.
Exact labels top to bottom, each once:
"画像を保存"
"スキャンとして保存"
"名前を変更"
"移動"
"複製"
"スターを付ける"
"アクセスを管理"
"ファイルの履歴"
"オフラインで使用"
"フォルダーで表示"
"印刷"
Typography Meiryo Regular14/24px tracking0, do not bold all labels. Logical width390px; compact44px minimum row targets. Icons consistent20-22px, left aligned; labels at consistent baseline, original glyph precision; OFF switch right only on row9. One white rounded sheet, subtle neutral edge/soft shadow. Thin quiet separators/inset dividers grouping rows as source; no eleven separate cards. Pure#FFFFFF canvas. All utility icons slate#526173, ink#1D1D1D, neutral OFF switch gray track and white knob LEFT.
Accent decision: Original menu icons are neutral, no selected/destructive state or dominant CTA exists in this list. Keep neutrality, no forced multicolor icons or green gradient button. Blue share action belongs outside this component and must not be added. No mint panels, glow or glossy materials.
Original fine details override mock. Preserve all11 labels/actions and OFF state; no source page header/share toolbar, extra action, added heading, watermark, IDs, device, captions or English. Static image only.
reviewNotes: 原図を優先して11操作・OFFトグル・アクセス歯車・雲の下矢印・フォルダーの虫眼鏡など自作の欠落を復元。生成を目視し全日本語ラベルと11行、OFF状態を確認。ただしスキャンの四隅の中にある長方形が欠けているため対象修正が必要。文字メトリクス厳密一致未証明。色は選択状態のない原図に沿い中立スレート、余計な緑の操作なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
